summary: A producer worried about the handling fee asks who controls the separate charge for pickup.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof relayed small producers' reports that their unregulated collection charges could be disproportionately high and asked lawmakers to consider ways to pay or regulate those costs.
